summary: Bullfrog's Dungeon Keeper is a dungeon-management strategy game best preserved through the Gold release and modern compatibility/fan-fix routes.

entries.title: Dungeon Keeper
entries.definitive_edition: Dungeon Keeper Gold with Deeper Dungeons; KeeperFX only if labeled

emulation.notes: Use GOG/Steam Gold for official route; KeeperFX as labeled secondary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Dungeon Keeper Gold with exact compatibility/fix state documented

primary.version: Dungeon Keeper Gold on GOG/Steam with KeeperFX documented separately if used
primary.why: The Gold route includes Deeper Dungeons and is the practical current official route via GOG/Steam, while KeeperFX is an important fan-maintained engine/fix route that changes behavior and should be labeled. The original DOS/Windows release remains the historical baseline.
primary.how_to_play: Use Dungeon Keeper Gold from GOG/Steam for the main route. Record storefront/build, DOSBox/Direct3D path, Deeper Dungeons state, resolution, mouse settings, level, multiplayer/LAN state, and whether KeeperFX was used.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting modern fixes or higher-resolution/community support.
secondary.why: It improves compatibility but is not the original executable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DOSBox/Direct3D/KeeperFX route and multiplayer state.
